scheduling_authority: none; historical draft frontier is informational, not an approved task queue

objective.statement: Classify which structured actions are represented by existing source-native continuations, preserving specified composition, relations, observations and witnesses.

nodes.statement: The actual six-edge directed path language acts on rooted histories by appending occurrences; supplied payload interpretations satisfy the chronological run-append law.
nodes.scope: Regular history action is source-defined. Alternative payload actions require interpretation. Geometric inverses do not become directed source occurrences.
nodes.verification: Sources inspected; original-rule compiler freshly checked separately in the preceding reconciliation. No fresh check of every cited root by this net.

nodes.statement: Over the supplied retained-comparison structure, set-valued actions retain units and composition; regular actions are given by postcomposition and Nat_E(E(p,-),D) is equivalent to D(p).
nodes.scope: Regular probes detect retained arrows; realization may forget them. The supplied structure and target action are not uniquely selected by this theorem. Structure.E is not the native dependent-extension constructor E.
nodes.verification: Source and reports inspected; no fresh Yoneda compiler run in this net.

nodes.statement: Specify an independently motivated bounded target action class and an exact source-action interface before asserting coverage.
nodes.next_action: Audit existing coverage results first; then name the source syntax, target action class, representation/comparison maps, allowed parameter producers, preserved relations and witness laws, and whether coverage means existence, fullness, faithfulness or classification of fibers.
nodes.deliverable: A typed coverage contract or a finding that an existing theorem already answers the selected question.
nodes.falsifier: An arbitrary target action is inserted as a free source parameter and its evaluation is reported as source-derived coverage.

nodes.statement: Candidate: the existing source-native continuation representation covers the independently specified target action class through comparisons preserving its declared composition, relations and retained witnesses.
nodes.scope: No target class is selected yet; this is a conjecture programme with an explicit specification gate, not a quantified theorem or a claim to cover all actions.
nodes.next_action: After the interface is frozen, reuse existing action and native-compilation theorems to construct the comparison, classify its image/fibers, or exhibit a target action excluded by a source invariant.
nodes.deliverable: A scoped representation/coverage theorem or explicit obstruction, with generated versus supplied data distinguished.
nodes.falsifier: An action in the declared target class has no source-generated representative preserving the required laws, or a claimed faithful comparison merges a required retained distinction.

frontier_semantics: Open nodes whose research prerequisites are resolved. Located prior constructions are reusable evidence, not newly verified theorems.
publication: owner-local successor plus operator-authorized epistemic graph registration; completed parent unchanged
